metadata.description: 23 mods for Claude Code. One panel.

plugins.name: modz
plugins.description: The MODZ panel. Opens beside the chat with a live line from every installed mod, one click to each mod's own pane.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Every agent gets a face: progress, cost and time for each subagent, live, in the Agents pane and a band above the prompt. Other chats waiting on you show at the top.

plugins.name: savvy-flow
plugins.description: Orchestrated delivery: the session model plans and reviews, five tiered worker agents implement. Pairs with savvy-progress.

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: A file tree of what Claude touches: what it is doing now, the files touched this turn and their git status. Does nothing until its pane is opened.

plugins.name: plan-steps
plugins.description: The plan's steps as Claude works through them, from the task list, an approved plan or a plan file. The plan comes back after /clear and compaction.

plugins.name: transceiver
plugins.description: Beta. Chat and zero-token agent questions between your own computers; team rooms across accounts are experimental.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds a shell command that would lose work (rm -rf, find -delete, git reset/checkout/clean/stash drop/branch -D, force pushes, writes over files, docker, terraform, kubectl and database drops) and shows exactly what it would lose. A command that loses nothing runs; one nobody can answer is refused. Also holds an edit to a file another chat just changed.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Stops keys and tokens before they land: scans writes, edits, text a Bash command writes, git add and commit, and blocks committing .env. If the guard fails, the write is blocked. Pasted keys reach the model as placeholders; /rec masks the screen.

plugins.name: checkpoint
plugins.description: A silent git snapshot before each turn's first write, from a file tool or a Bash command that may write. /checkpoints lists the turns and undoes one; each session in each worktree sees only its own. Git-ignored files are not covered.

plugins.name: test-badge
plugins.description: After you allow it once per folder, runs tests and lint in the package you edited and shows the result as a badge; a failed run is offered to your next prompt. Watches your PR's GitHub CI too.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Replays the last turn's edits step by step, each tied to its plan step, with a coloured diff; earlier turns and past sessions too. Opens from /replay.

plugins.name: session-budget
plugins.description: A spend budget per session, as a share of the 5-hour limit (or the weekly one without it) or in dollars: a notice at 80%, a stop at 100%, and a question before new subagents when the window runs low.

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: Shows what a cold send would cost, after a break or a model change, and can keep the one-hour prompt cache warm. Keepwarm starts only on request, stops after 12 pings, and uses tokens.

plugins.name: hud-pro
plugins.description: One quiet line above the prompt: the 5-hour limit and its reset, 7-day use, context and session cost; alerts only on the desktop by default (/hud band). The Usage pane shows what fills the context and 7 or 30 days of usage history.

plugins.name: done-ping
plugins.description: A notification when a long turn finishes or Claude is waiting on you, with optional sound packs. On the desktop it stays quiet unless tests failed or the turn ended on an error.

plugins.name: reflect-mod
plugins.description: Spots corrections in your prompts worth keeping and saves them to the CLAUDE.md you choose (this project by default); /reflect-undo takes the last one back. /mine turns friction that repeats across past chats into ideas.

plugins.name: skins
plugins.description: Themes for the transcript: tool rows, reply gutters and spinner words, and living ASCII scenes above the prompt. /skin switches them live. It never cuts output short.

plugins.name: terminal-browser
plugins.description: A browser inside the terminal: preview sites and HTML files and let the agent drive it. Terminal only; needs the external terminal-browser CLI.

plugins.name: effort-router
plugins.description: Shows each turn's effort and model. In auto mode, light prompts go at low effort; a short follow-up goes at your own effort, and a lowered turn has a re-send button.

plugins.name: wrapped
plugins.description: Your year with Claude Code as a story and a video, from your own transcripts: persona, which agents did the work, month by month. /wrapped; Hide names masks project and file names before you share. Uses no model tokens.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Before the context fills, writes a handoff note; your next chat in this repo is offered it (Continue from handoff). Notes live in the main repository.

plugins.name: pr-card
plugins.description: A card in the conversation for a PR Claude opens or the branch already has: files with the largest changes on the desktop, checks, review and merge state in the terminal. No poller of its own.

plugins.name: projects
plugins.description: Every project in one place: percent, plans, where it stopped, tokens and agents; /projects and a full-screen board
